# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.48

Changes since version 0.0.47.

## Fixed

- Windows startup checks whether a restored Commander window is actually hidden before enabling file actions. If the window is uniquely identified and remains hidden on a second check, the extension reopens its own panel through the normal new-window path. Saved folder tabs and their active positions are retained. The recovery is part of the extension and does not modify VS Code application files.
- Window ownership checks are read-only, scoped to a temporary title identifier, and cancelled when the panel closes. Visible, minimized, ambiguous and unrelated windows do not trigger recovery. A replacement panel cannot repeat the restoration recovery.

## Known limitations

- The recovery targets an initialized webview with an identifiable, hidden native Windows window. It does not verify rendered pixels or recover a failed VS Code webview service-worker initialization. An unavailable or inconclusive window inspection leaves the existing panel intact and records the reason in startup diagnostics.
- Automated lifecycle and state-preservation checks do not replace the pending visible startup validation. Support for future VS Code versions remains subject to compatibility testing.
- Reload or restart VS Code after installing the update to activate the new extension code and native module.
